To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
digitalization is not a magic solution to the challenges of knowledge work performance.

digitalization in knowledge work does not enhance performance, because it creates more work, more stress and less time for knowledge work, and that this is due to the lack of digitalization management.

knowledge workers experience more value destroying than value creating effects in digitalization, and the most important areas for managerial attention are the effects of digital technology on knowledge workers’ autonomy and control over their work.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of the digitalization on the performance of knowledge work.
the impact of digitalization on performance in knowledge work.
the question of what are the effects of digitalizing knowledge work on its performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

digitalization is not a silver bullet for knowledge work performance, but a tool for improving it, and the key to the benefits of digitalization is to understand and manage the value destroying effects.
even though knowledge work has changed, the nature of work has not.
digitalization is not a panacea for knowledge work performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
even though the digitalization of knowledge work has the potential to enhance the performance, it also brings with it new challenges and risks that need to be addressed.
the digitalization in knowledge work is not a straightforward path to enhanced performance.
the digitalization of knowledge work is still a work in progress and the effects on performance remain to be seen.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effects of digital transformation on knowledge work are not as straightforward as expected and that the effects on knowledge work performance can be negative as well as positive.
digitalization does not necessarily lead to performance enhancement, but rather to the opposite.
digitalization in knowledge work does not guarantee performance enhancement, but it does offer a great deal of potential for it.
